messages:
Zoe W: Observed customer report: invoice preview showed cost for a bunch of sessions that later vanished. Root cause looks like final token events delayed by DLQ for ~40m. Proposal: emit a provisional 'scan' line in preview so customers see expected cost and we can reconcile later.

Ben C: Important: provisional lines must be clearly labeled and excluded from exports until committed. Also need stable matching keys (provenance_id or client_req_id).

Maya R: Agreed. Minimal schema additions: provisional:true, provenance_id, estimate_tokens, estimate_cents, provisional_ttl_seconds. Reconcile API supports commit/adjust/void.

Priya S: Console UX: show a subtle orange "Provisional" badge on the line with hover text "Estimate emitted due to ingest gap; final may change." Add tenant-level toggle "Hide provisional from exports" and an audit log entry when ops force-commits.

Ben C: Metrics: billing.provisional_emitted, billing.provisional_committed, billing.provisional_delta_pct. Alert if reconcile_delta_pct > 1% for >1h.

Maya R: Rollout plan: feature flag billing.provisional_scan.v1, opt-in tenants. Canary 10 -> 100. Also add reconcile webhook for customers who want notifications.

ingest-bot: deploy-bot: billing-service v2.18.1 deployed to staging with billing.provisional_scan.v1=false.

Zoe W: I'll write the short design note and add PRs for schema + console copy. Tagging @Priya S @Ben C for review.
